note: The Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada's response (2011-2014), quoting Decree D/95/254/PRG/SGG of 1995 and the 2008 order on fees: the card is compulsory from 15 (art. 3) and valid five years, renewable (art. 2); a stamp duty of GNF 5,000 and an issuing fee of GNF 10,000, summed here. These are the latest terms found; the time isn't stated.

sources.title: Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada, Guinea: National identity card (2011-2014), on ecoi.net
sources.said: The national identity card is mandatory for all citizens from fifteen (15) years of age (Guinea 1995, art. 3) The national identity card is valid for a renewable term of five (5) years and is issued only to Guinean nationals (ibid., Art. 2). ... Duty on stamp to be applied = 5,000 Guinean francs (GNF) [C$0.80] Fee for issuing the national identity card = 10,000 GNF [C$1.60]
